verdict.rationale: The evidence shows API v2 with official SDKs, a graphical Job Builder, and Signed URLs for on-demand conversion. None of these is a documented one-line command or CLI for converting a file from scripts or CI. SDKs are developer building blocks, and Signed URLs are an adjacent API feature, not a documented conversion command, so the axis applies but is not delivered.

support.subject: As a developer, a documented command converts a file in one line, usable from scripts and CI
